parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。

parameters.name: ValidityPeriod
parameters.description: 有效周期的时间范围，当**ValidityType**为**time_bound**时生效。

parameters.name: ValidityType
parameters.description:
关系有效期类型，取值可选范围：
- permanent：永久
- time_bound：自定义时间范围

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam add-user-to-authorization-rule --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --authorization-rule-id arrule_01kf143ug06fg7m9f43u7vahxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --validity-type permanent --validity-period EndTime=1704062061000 StartTime=1704042061000 --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam AddUserToAuthorizationRule --region cn-hangzhou --ValidityPeriod.StartTime 1704042061000 --ValidityPeriod.EndTime 1704062061000 --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ValidityType permanent --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --AuthorizationRuleId arrule_01kf143ug06fg7m9f43u7vahxxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --method POST --force
